linkedin: AI is now listed in 12% of active remote jobs — 487 of 3,928 listings we analyzed explicitly require AI skills. It still trails communication (41%) but sits ahead of leadership (11%) and sales (9%). The top disclosed pay: USD 132,400–238,400 a year for a Sr. Principal Product Engineer at Jabil. Only 22% of listings disclose pay, so 78% hide salary — negotiate with market data, not posted figures. AI roles span engineering to people ops and sales, so don't assume AI is only for developers. If you have AI skills, add a dedicated section and link a repo; companies still weigh communication and domain expertise. Full numbers and methodology: https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/ai-skills-in-demand-for-remote-jobs-2026
